title: Composed layout workbench on Wayland
scenario: P11 · Keyboard focus, summary reflow, modal recovery and narrow/wide resize on a private Wayland output.
fixture: Default composed layout workbench on a private output, initially 1024 × 768 at scale 1

slides.caption: Dataset has keyboard focus
slides.expected: The Dataset editor and results collection share the window.

slides.caption: Focus moves to Summary
slides.expected: The Summary control gains the keyboard focus indicator.

slides.caption: The expanded summary moves the content down
slides.expected: The summary occupies more vertical space above the work area.

slides.caption: The dialog owns focus
slides.action: Tab to Dialog and press Return.
slides.expected: The active controls are inside the modal.

slides.caption: Escape restores the Dialog button
slides.expected: The modal closes, focus returns to its launcher and Dataset retains its original value.

slides.caption: Narrow layout
slides.expected: The single-column layout removes the vertical splitter.

slides.caption: Restored wide layout
slides.expected: The form and results panes share the width again and the splitter returns.
